```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 7,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  dpi = 150
)
```

```{r load}
library(censusindia)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
```

```{r data}
districts <- census_2011_pca |>
  mutate(
    sc_pct = share(sc_population, population),
    st_pct = share(st_population, population)
  )

map_df <- attach_geometry(districts, 2011, geography = "district")
```

```{r map-population}
plot_map(map_df, "population",
  title = "District population (Census 2011)",
  subtitle = "Log scale. Thane (MH) at 11 million, Dibang Valley (AR) at 8,000",
  trans = "log10", labels = label_comma(), legend_title = "Population", unit_boundary_color = "grey60", unit_boundary_width = 0.05,
  show_state_boundaries = TRUE, state_boundary_color = "grey20", state_boundary_width = 0.4
)
```

```{r map-sc}
plot_map(map_df, "sc_pct",
  title = "Scheduled Caste population share (Census 2011)",
  palette = "oranges", labels = label_number(suffix = "%"), legend_title = "SC (%)", unit_boundary_color = "grey60", unit_boundary_width = 0.05,
  show_state_boundaries = TRUE, state_boundary_color = "grey20", state_boundary_width = 0.4
)
```

```{r map-st}
plot_map(map_df, "st_pct",
  title = "Scheduled Tribe population share (Census 2011)",
  palette = "greens", labels = label_number(suffix = "%"), legend_title = "ST (%)", unit_boundary_color = "grey60", unit_boundary_width = 0.05,
  show_state_boundaries = TRUE, state_boundary_color = "grey20", state_boundary_width = 0.4
)
```

```{r table-top-bottom}
districts |>
  arrange(desc(population)) |>
  slice(c(1:10, (n() - 9):n())) |>
  mutate(
    rank = c(1:10, (nrow(districts) - 9):nrow(districts)),
    population = format(population, big.mark = ",")
  ) |>
  select(rank, district, state_name_harmonized, population) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Rank", "District", "State/UT", "Population"),
    caption = "Ten most and least populous districts (Census 2011)"
  )
```
